nextStoryContext: US-004 added `cam patterns prune` (src/commands/patterns-prune.ts: computePruneDecision + prunePatternRecordsOnMain) alongside the pre-existing `cam patterns archive`. parsePatternsArgs/ParsedPatternsArgs/PatternsDispatchDeps/dispatchPatterns in index.ts now route on parsed.mode ('archive' | 'prune'); PATTERNS_USAGE is 'cam patterns archive|prune'. Decision logic (computePruneDecision, pure, no git) has 3 independent triggers evaluated per record, at most ONE demotion firing per record per run: (1) shelf-life staleness wins outright and archives DIRECTLY -- tactical >30d, observational >14d, measured from the MOST RECENT of recorded_at and any outcome's recorded_at; foundational is exempt (no shelf life); (2) confirmationScore (src/patterns/record.ts) below PRUNE_SCORE_THRESHOLD=1, only when outcomes.length>0 (zero-outcome records are exempt -- unconfirmed but not disproven), demotes ONE tier via the chain foundational->tactical->observational->archived; (3) anchor-decay (dir_anchors non-empty AND every anchor fails existsSync relative to cwd) also demotes one tier, same chain. PatternClassification (src/patterns/record.ts) has only 3 string values (foundational|tactical|observational) -- there is NO 4th 'archived' classification string; demoting past observational means REMOVAL from pattern-records.jsonl into a new companion file, PATTERN_RECORDS_ARCHIVE_JSONL_PATH='scripts/cam/pattern-records.archive.jsonl' (lazily created on main, same posture as patterns.archive.md). prunePatternRecordsOnMain follows the CAM-300 per-attempt CAS recompute discipline (patterns.md line ~762): the FileWritesFn callback passed to commitTreeToMain re-reads BOTH pattern-records.jsonl and pattern-records.archive.jsonl from the advanced main on every retry attempt and re-runs computePruneDecision against that fresh content, rather than a static FileWrite[] computed once up front -- this matters because prunePatternRecordsOnMain overwrites the WHOLE active-store file, and a concurrent appendPatternRecordOnMain/appendOutcomeOnMain write landing mid-retry must survive. A pre-mutation check (read + decide once before entering the CAS loop) short-circuits to a clean no-op ({ok:true, pruned:0, demoted:0, archived:0, sha:''}) when nothing needs changing, so no empty commit ever fires. Sentinel: CAM_PATTERNS_PRUNED=<n> sha=<sha> on mutation, CAM_PATTERNS_PRUNED=noop otherwise (n = demoted+archived count from the WINNING CAS attempt). readPatternRecordsContentFromMain was changed from private to exported in src/commands/pattern-records.ts so patterns-prune.ts could reuse the same `git show main:pattern-records.jsonl` wrapper instead of duplicating it (jscpd-avoidance, same rationale as the checkMainUpToDate/commitTreeToMain/pushMainBestEffort shared exports). No CLI flags for any threshold (score/shelf-life/anchor-decay are fixed constants exported from patterns-prune.ts, not configurable per invocation) -- if a future story needs per-project tuning, that would be a new AC, not an extension of this one. Not yet wired: nothing currently calls prunePatternRecordsOnMain automatically (unlike patterns archive, which US-003 auto-invoked from `cam journal append --cycle-close`) -- a future story may want to add the same auto-invoke-at-cycle-close wiring for prune, mirroring patternsArchiveFn's best-effort/non-fatal call-order slot in dispatchJournal.
